# Introduction to Sent Message Types

This document introduces all the currently supported message types on SeaTalk Open Platform that can be sent out by system accounts or bots.

In a nutshell, every message object contains a "tag" field that specifies the message type and an object whose name and constituent fields vary based on the message type.

# Text Message with/without Formatting

## Message Example

![](data:image/png;base64,)

    {
        "tag":"text",
        "text":{
            "content":"Hi <mention-tag target=\"seatalk://user?id=0\"/>, this is a text message with supported formats.\nYou would see:\n1. **bold**\n2. *italic*\n3. `inline code`\n- List item 1\n- List item 2\n```\nCode Block\n```"
        }
    } Copy

## Parameters

|Parameter|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|tag|string|The type of the message|
|text|object|The information about the text|
|∟content|string|- The content of the text message with markdown syntax supported - Refer to this document for supported markdown elements|

# Image

## Message Example

```json
{
    "tag":"image",
    "image":{
        "content":"iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAIAAAACCAYAAABytg0kAAAAFElEQVQYV2P8/uPnfwYGBgZGGAMAVe4H0WDm+2kAAAAASUVORK5CYII="
    }
} Copy
```

## Parameters

|Parameter|Type|Mandatory|Length Limit|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|tag|string|Yes|N/A|The type of the message, in this case, is ' image '.|
|image|object|Yes|N/A|The image message object|
|∟content|string|Yes|Maximum 5MB after encoding|- The Base64-encoded image file - Only PNG, JPG and GIF images are supported|

# Interactive Message Card

For a comprehensive introduction to how to build an interactive message card, see[Interactive Message Cards - Build a Card](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/interactive-msg_build-a-card).

## Message Example

![](data:image/png;base64,)

```json
{
    "tag":"interactive_message",
    "interactive_message":{
        "default":{
            "elements":[
                {
                    "element_type":"title",
                    "title":{
                        "text":"Mail pending for collection"
                    }
                },
                {
                    "element_type":"description",
                    "description":{
                        "text":"You have a mail at the office lobby pending for collection. Please visit the lobby during the office hours to collect it."
                    }
                },
                {
                    "element_type":"button",
                    "button":{
                        "button_type":"redirect",
                        "text":"View details",
                        "mobile_link":{
                            "type":"web",
                            "path":"https://webApp.com/somePath"
                        },
                        "desktop_link":{
                            "type":"web",
                            "path":"https://webApp.com/somePath"
                        }
                    }
                },
                {
                    "element_type":"button",
                    "button":{
                        "button_type":"callback",
                        "text":"I have collected it",
                        "value":"collected"
                    }
                }
            ]
        },
        "zh-Hans":{
            "elements":[
                {
                    "element_type":"title",
                    "title":{
                        "text":"待取信件"
                    }
                },
                {
                    "element_type":"description",
                    "description":{
                        "text":"你有一封待取的信件，请在办公时间段前往大厅领取。"
                    }
                },
                {
                    "element_type":"button",
                    "button":{
                        "button_type":"redirect",
                        "text":"查看详情",
                        "mobile_link":{
                            "type":"web",
                            "path":"https://webApp.com/somePath"
                        },
                        "desktop_link":{
                            "type":"web",
                            "path":"https://webApp.com/somePath"
                        }
                    }
                },
                {
                    "element_type":"button",
                    "button":{
                        "button_type":"callback",
                        "text":"我已取件",
                        "value":"collected"
                    }
                }
            ]
        }
    }
} Copy
```

## Parameters

|Parameter|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|tag|string|The type of the message|
|interactive\_message|object|The information about the interactive message card. For a comprehensive introduction to how to build an interactive message card, see Interactive Message Cards - Build a Card|

# File

## Message Example

```json
{
    "tag":"file",
    "file":{
        "filename":"demo.txt",
        "content":"VGhpcyBpcyBhIGRlbW8gdGV4dCBmaWxlLgo="
    }
} Copy
```

## Parameters

|Parameter|Type|Mandatory|Length Limit|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|tag|string|Yes|N/A|The type of the message, in this case, is 'file'.|
|file|object|Yes|N/A|The file message object|
|∟content|string|Yes|Maximum 5MB and Minimum 10B after encoding|- The Base64-encoded file - All file types are supported including Images (only PNG, JPG, and GIF have preview in client)|
|∟filename|string|Yes|100 characters|The file name with extension; files with no extension specified will be sent as unidentified files|

# Markdown Message (Phasing out)

**\*\*Note\*\*:**

* SeaTalk is **phasing out the "Markdown” message type** in favor of the more flexible markdown formatting syntax concept that can be embedded into not only text messages but all applicable message types.
* It is recommended to **use the "text" message type in producing formatted text messages.**

## Message Example

![](data:image/png;base64,)

```json
{
    "tag":"markdown",
    "markdown":{
        "content":"This is a Markdown msg.\n\nYou should see:\n\n1. __bold__\n\n2. *Italics*\n\n- List item 1\n\n- List item 2"
    }
} Copy
```

## Parameters

|Parameter|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|tag|string|The type of the message|
|markdown|object|The information about the Markdown message|
|∟content|string|The content of the Markdown message|

## Markdown Elements Supported

|Element|Effect|
|---|---|
|Bold|This is a bold word|
|Italic|This is an italic word|
|Ordered lists|1. Item 1 2. Item 2|
|Unordered list|- Item 1 - Item 2|

Note (for text=markdown):

* To make a new line, use **two** newline characters (i.e., \\n\\n) or the <br /> line break tag (note the space in between).
* However, to make **consecutive** new lines, only**multiple** <br /> line break tags (i.e., <br /><br />) are allowed.
